To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The functional connectivity graph of the human brain can be altered according to the upcoming task even before an action needs to be executed.
The functional connectivity graph of the visuomotor functional network is altered according to and thus predicted the upcoming task already during a preparational phase before a movement.
the brain changes its functional connectivity structure according to the upcoming task even before the task is executed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question how humans are able to flexibly adapt to changing environmental situations.
the brain's ability to adapt its functional connectivity to the current situation and thereby to prepare for upcoming task requirements.
the question, how the brain prepares for different motor responses in different situations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the brain is able to prepare for different tasks by altering the connectivity structure of a large-scale functional network.
the functional integration of a large-scale network is altered according to and predicts the upcoming task, and that the network structure is biased according to the task rule.
the functional integration within the cortical visuomotorsystem changes according to the upcoming task already before a visual cue and the movement is presented.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the functional integration of a large-scale brain system is altered according to and predicts upcoming task conditions.
the brain prepares for different tasks by changing its functional connectivity structure in advance of an actual response.
the functional integration of a large scale network is biased by the task condition.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the human brain can flexibly adapt the functional connectivity structure to upcoming task demands.
the brain prepares for upcoming tasks by altering the functional connectivity structure.
the functional connectivity structure of a network can change depending on the task and that the connectivity topology is predictive of the upcoming task.
